title: Fostering Recruitment Officer
description:
As a Recruitment Officer within our Fostering Recruitment and Assessment Team, you'll help find safe, supportive homes for children in our care. You'll be the first point of contact for prospective foster carers, guiding them through the early stages and inspiring them to begin their fostering journey.

This is a varied, rewarding role where you'll combine recruitment, relationship-building, and event delivery to make a real difference to children's lives.

What you'll do:
- Be the first point of contact for prospective foster carers, responding to enquiries with warmth and clear guidance.
- Support applicants through the early stages, including home visits and helping complete checks and assessments.
- Promote fostering at events (virtual and in person), inspiring people to take the next step.
- Manage and maintain accurate records using case management systems.
- Screen and assess prospective carers, gathering and analysing information to support decision-making.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues and partners to grow our fostering community and ensure safeguarding standards are met.

What we're looking for:
- Experience (paid or voluntary) of working with children, young people, or families in a caring or supportive role.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence a wide range of people.
- Strong organisational and IT skills, with confidence using Microsoft 365 and managing accurate records.
- Ability to assess, analyse, and present information clearly to support sound decision-making.
- A collaborative approach, with the ability to build effective relationships with colleagues, partners, and communities.
- A values-driven approach, demonstrating empathy, inclusivity, and a commitment to supporting children in care.

To learn more about this role, please review our Candidate Pack available on our website. Please click on the Apply button for details.

Why join us?
- Be part of Hampshire Children's Services - rated Outstanding by Ofsted - and help shape the future of fostering.
- Enjoy a varied, rewarding role where your work directly impacts children's lives and strengthens communities.
- Access to Health Assured's comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme to support your physical and mental wellbeing, including 24/7 telephone support, a suite of online resources, and legal and financial advice.
- Competitive benefits package, including generous annual leave, occupational sick pay, and access to the Local Government Pension Scheme. Find more information here .

Applicants can expect to hear from us within two weeks of the advertised closing date.

Please note: We are unable to offer sponsorship for this role and therefore it is essential that you already have the right to work in the UK.

Other roles you may have experience of may include: Recruitment Officer, Talent Acquisition Officer, Recruitment Coordinator, Community Engagement Officer, or Fostering Support Officer.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Liberty Recruitment Group are delighted to be working with a well-established education organisation in Winchester to recruit a Temporary HR Assistant to join their busy and friendly HR team for an initial period of at least four weeks. This full-time office-based role is paying up to £26,300 (FTE)

Supporting a workforce of over 800 staff across two sites in Winchester, this is a varied, hands-on administrative role where you'll play an important part in keeping the HR function running smoothly.

You don't necessarily need previous HR experience, although this would be advantageous. We're looking for someone who is professional, approachable and confident communicating with people at all levels. You'll need to be highly organised, comfortable juggling competing priorities and happy working with both digital systems and paper-based processes.

What you'll be doing:
- Managing the HR personnel inbox, responding to general queries and directing enquiries to the appropriate team member.
- Answering telephone calls and face-to-face enquiries, providing friendly support and signposting colleagues to the right person or policy.
- Recording absence information on the HR system and producing daily absence reports for senior management.
- Supporting recruitment and assessment days, including preparing interview packs, timetables, setting up rooms and assisting candidates.
- Supporting DBS checks, including taking copies of identification documents.
- Providing general HR administration, handling information sensitively and maintaining accurate records.

Additional Information:
- Initial assignment of at least four weeks.
- Enhanced DBS required, with the successful candidate able to register/update their certificate on the DBS Update Service.
- Parking available on a first-come, first-served basis.
- Approximately 10 minutes' walk from Winchester railway station.

Please get in touch with Liberty Recruitment Group to find out more

title: Onboarding Coordinator
description:
Onboarding Coordinator Join an Ambitious Team Driving Operational Excellence

This is a pivotal position within the Group Support team, responsible for managing the onboarding and ongoing compliance of contractors operating within highly regulated industries.

You'll oversee the full contractor lifecycle, from initial onboarding through to contract extensions, compliance renewals and client-specific changes. Workloads can vary significantly, with some contractors onboarding months in advance while others require mobilisation at very short notice, making this a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Success in this role comes from balancing exceptional attention to detail with commercial awareness. You'll be expected to follow established processes while also having the confidence to question information, identify potential risks and challenge stakeholders when something doesn't look right.

Working closely with Sales, Agency Pay, Contractors and Clients, you'll play a key role in ensuring compliance requirements are met while delivering a positive and seamless onboarding experience.

Key Responsibilities

Managing the end-to-end onboarding process for new contractors.

Ensuring contractor records meet regulatory, legislative and client-specific compliance requirements.

Processing contract change requests, including extensions and amendments.

Supporting ongoing contractor compliance through document renewals and status updates.

Conducting client audits and identifying compliance gaps, risks and improvement opportunities.

Building strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Participating in client meetings, particularly with high-volume accounts.

Monitoring onboarding activity and prioritising workload across the team.

Continuously reviewing and improving processes to drive efficiency and enhance the contractor experience.

Working with systems including Bullhorn and TIFO to maintain accurate records and compliance documentation.

Supporting automation initiatives and identifying opportunities to streamline administrative processes.

What's in it for you?

Be Part of an Ambitious Team with Big Goals
This is a team that's striving for excellence, with a clear aspiration of being recognised as Team of the Year. You'll be joining a driven, tenacious group that takes pride in delivering outstanding results while supporting one another along the way.

A Varied Role with Real Business Impact
No two days are the same. You'll work across multiple departments, build relationships throughout the business and play a key role in enhancing the customer journey. This isn't a role where you're siloed into one area; you'll have visibility, influence and the opportunity to make a genuine impact.

Innovation Meets Human Connection
The team embraces new technologies and innovative ways of working, while recognising that strong relationships remain at the heart of success. You'll use technology to improve efficiency, but you'll also be encouraged to pick up the phone, collaborate with stakeholders and build genuine connections.

We are looking for individuals who:

We are looking for individuals who:

Thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Have exceptional attention to detail and take pride in getting things right first time.

Are tenacious and resilient when managing competing priorities.

Can confidently multitask and adapt to changing demands.

Enjoy building relationships and aren't afraid to pick up the phone to resolve issues quickly.

Have strong interpersonal skills and can influence stakeholders at all levels.

Are comfortable following process but confident enough to challenge when necessary.

Enjoy problem-solving and identifying smarter ways of working.

Have experience within compliance, onboarding, operations, customer service, contractor support or other process-driven environments.

Why Join Gattaca?

At Gattaca, you'll be part of a business that combines ambition with purpose. You'll work alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about delivering great outcomes for customers, candidates and each other.

We're committed to creating an environment where people can thrive, develop and make a meaningful impact.

Interested in joining us?
As an Onboarding Coordinator, you'll play a critical role in delivering a seamless contractor journey, ensuring compliance excellence and driving continuous improvement. If you're looking for a varied role where your contribution genuinely matters, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and be part of something bigger at Gattaca.

Recruitment Process

Gattaca is dedicated to helping our people to realise their full potential. We understand the value a diverse workforce brings to every workplace and in everything we do, we are committed to promoting diversity, inclusion and accessibility. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and encourage you to consider a career with Gattaca, if there is anything we can do to make our recruitment processes better for you, tell us.

Our recruitment process will include a combination of telephone, video and face to face interviews for you to showcase your talents and potential.

We offer reasonable adjustments to accommodate the needs of our applicants, such as providing interview questions in advance, offering written formats, changing interview times, structure, or settings, and arranging office visits before the interview. This list is not exhaustive, and we are open to considering any additional adjustments to support our candidates.

title: People Assistant
description:
Liberty Recruitment Group are delighted to be working exclusively with a fantastic, well-established organisation in the search for a People Assistant to join their friendly and supportive HR team.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone looking to start their career in HR, or perhaps someone with a little HR administration experience who is keen to develop their knowledge within a collaborative and people-focused environment.

Based in Southampton or Salisbury, this is a full-time, permanent and office-based role, offering a salary of circa £25,000, depending on experience.

Key responsibilities:
- Coordinate new starter processes, including preparing welcome packs, employment documentation and delivering inductions
- Manage leaver administration, including relevant paperwork and reference requests
- Record and update absence, annual leave, flexi-time and employee benefits information
- Support the coordination of training, CPD and wider learning and development activities
- Support the recruitment team with interview coordination, CV screening and candidate administration when required
- Coordinate work experience placements and support wider employee initiatives
- Respond to employee queries, providing a friendly and professional service
- Assist with HR compliance activity, including DBS checks and GDPR requirements
- Organise regular team review meetings and provide general administrative support to the wider HR team

About you
- Previous administration experience would be advantageous, although not essential
- A genuine interest in HR and developing a career within People & Culture
- A naturally people-focused approach with strong emotional intelligence
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Professional, approachable and confident communicating with people at all levels
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Full UK driving licence, as occasional travel between offices will be required

If you're looking to take your first steps into HR, or build on your existing experience within a supportive and friendly team, we would love to hear from you!

Please get in touch with the team at Liberty Recruitment Group to find out more.

title: Resourcer / Delivery Consultant
description:
Resourcer / Delivery Consultant

Transportation and Buildings

Location

Port Solent, Portsmouth

Hours

Monday to Friday, full time, early Friday finish

Salary

Competitive salary plus incentives

Reports to

Department Manager, Transportation and Buildings

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Resourcer or Delivery Consultant to support our Transportation and Buildings teams. The level of the role is matched to your experience.

You will find and engage the right candidates for our consultants' vacancies across highways, rail, building services and construction. It is the ideal foundation for progressing into a full 360 consultant role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Source, screen and shortlist candidates using the CRM, job boards, LinkedIn and your own network
- Recruit engineers, designers, project managers, site managers and building services professionals
- Advertise vacancies and network proactively to build strong talent pools
- Interview candidates to understand their skills and motivations, and match them accurately to roles
- Manage candidates through the process, keeping them informed and engaged
- Handle queries on contracts, pay and logistics
- Keep the CRM accurate, generate call lists and maintain compliance standards
- Deliver against activity KPIs and contribute to team targets

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Confident on the phone, with strong verbal and written communication
- Builds rapport quickly and puts people at ease
- Persuasive, persistent and patient
- Organised, able to prioritise and work to deadlines
- Resilient, flexible and adaptable
- Good IT skills and quick to learn new systems
- Resourcing or recruitment experience in technical markets is an advantage; the right attitude matters most and full training is provided

ABOUT ADVANCE TRS

Advance TRS is an award-winning technical recruitment business specialising in the Built Environment and Infrastructure markets. We are one of the fastest-growing recruitment companies in the UK, with offices in Port Solent (Portsmouth), Guildford and London.

We grew by 40% last year and are on track to do the same again, through organic growth, new offices and strategic acquisitions. We reward success, promote from within and celebrate together as one team.

WHAT WE OFFER

A competitive salary and a rewards package built to recognise performance and support your wellbeing.

Rewards and incentives
- Incentive lunches, vouchers and team activities
- Delivery recognition, including a place on the annual overseas incentive trip for the standout performer
- A clear route into a 360 consultant role
- Long service awards, including experience gifts at 5, 10 and 15 years

Time off and wellbeing
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, rising with service to 30 days
- Birthday day off after one year
- Early Friday finish
- Weekly wellness hour
- Private medical insurance after one year, including private GP and an Employee Assistance Programme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
- Perkbox perks and discounts platform

Financial security
- Company pension with 5% employer contribution
- Life assurance at three times basic salary

Team and culture
- Summer and Christmas parties, days out, golf, go-karting and regular team socials
- Structured training, coaching and clearly defined career paths

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV to (url removed). For a confidential conversation about the role first, get in touch at the same address.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Temporary HR Administrator
description:
Temporary HR Administrator
Location: Winchester
Salary: £13.06 per hour
Duration: 4 8 weeks - Immediate start
Hours: 37.5 hours per week Monday Friday, 8:30am 5:00pm (1-hour lunch break)
30 hours a week would also be considered within the above operational hours.
Enhanced DBS required
We are currently recruiting for a Temporary HR Administrator to join a busy and friendly team on an initial 4 8 week assignment. This is a varied administrative role, ideal for someone with strong organisational and communication skills with an enhanced DBS who enjoys working in a people-focused environment. You will play an important role in supporting the HR department, acting as a first point of contact for enquiries and ensuring queries are directed to the right people.
Key Responsibilities
- Monitoring and responding to the HR department inbox.
- Answering telephone calls and responding to face-to-face enquiries.
- Acting as the first point of contact, directing enquiries and requests to the relevant departments or individuals.
- Carrying out DBS checks and supporting associated administration.
- Providing general administrative support to the HR team.
- Supporting recruitment activity, including booking interview rooms and greeting candidates.
- Preparing and organising new starter packs.
- Ensuring all administrative processes are completed accurately and efficiently.

About You
- Must have enhanced DBS to apply for this job
- At least 2 years' experience in an administrative role.
- Previous HR administration experience would be advantageous.
- Experience carrying out DBS checks would also be beneficial.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident dealing with enquiries both over the telephone and face-to-face.
- Highly organised, proactive and able to manage a varied workload.
- A friendly, approachable manner with a professional attitude.

What's on Offer?
- £13.06 per hour.
- 4 8 week temporary assignment.
- 37.5-hour working week.
- Monday Friday, 8:30am 5:00pm.
- Convenient location, just a 10-minute walk from the train station.

If you are an organised administrator with an enhanced DBS looking for an immediate temporary opportunity within a busy HR team, we would love to hear from you!
